campaign.name: Beat the surface code at k=10, weight-4, 2D single-layer

direction.hypothesis: A weight-4 2D-local code can beat the cell frontier entry 368-8-8 (k=8, d=8, n=368, kd^2/n=1.39) on kd^2/n; target kd^2/n > 1.39 (e.g. k>=8, d>=8, n<368), in a cell whose entries sit at 1.2-1.4 where Bravyi-Poulin-Terhal gives only a constant factor.

bar.note: Cell frontier entry (exact); 2D single-layer weight-4 entries currently reach 1.2-1.4.

direction.feasibility: Weight-4 2D-local cell already populated; board_bar.py can price candidates before distance search; upside is a constant factor only.

novelty.claim: Push the weight-4 2D-local frontier beyond (k=8,d=8,n=368); not the first multi-logical result in this cell (15 entries already exist).

direction.expected_value: A weight-4 2D-local code on the cell frontier at kd^2/n > 1.4 would be a constant-factor improvement in a cell currently at 1.2-1.4; a 2D single-layer code has kd^2 = O(n) (Bravyi, Poulin, Terhal).

abandon_criterion.note: Drop the ladder if two consecutive rungs agree below the bar.

direction.what_a_negative_would_teach: Whether weight-4 2D-local constructions can reach k~10 at all, or whether the cell is structurally capped below that.
